subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to replace the italicised word.**

There is a/an __***abundance***__ of fertile soil and magnificent grazing land.
solution:
The correct answer is "dearth."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The word "abundance" means a very large quantity of something. (किसी वस्‍तु की बहुत बड़ी मात्रा; बहुलता, प्रचुरता)

 
 
• Example:* There was an **abundance**__ of food at the wedding.*
 
 
 
• So, the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'abundance' from the given sentence is "dearth."
 
• "Dearth" means a lack of something; not enough of something. (किसी वस्‍तु की कमी; अपर्याप्त)
 __
 
• Example: *There’s a **dearth**__ of young people in the village.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Plenitude: **a state of fullness, abundance, or completeness. (परिपूर्णता, प्रचुरता की अवस्था)
 
• **Plethora: **a very large amount of something, usually more than is needed or can be used. (आवश्यकता से अधिक; भरमार; प्रचुरता; बाहुलता; आधिक्य)
 
• **Adequacy: **the state or quality of being adequate. (पर्याप्तता, उपयुक्तता)
